description: Tasks. fetch.max_files: how many files one `task fetch` may copy. task_file_reminder: a prompt that wrote task files but not TASK.md is asked once, at Stop, to update it. review: a task with [review]=n may use n + extra_checks checks before a person must allow more; max_n caps the n a prompt can ask for. snapshots: how long the copies made at the gates are kept, and the largest file that is copied.
